item.title: Sentinels: identity, PoW links, paid service, audit and the Bitcoin relay
item.body:
Turn the Sentinel from a registration that pays everyone equally into a bonded,
identified, audited node that relays and adds work to transactions, serves wallets signed
answers and is paid for what the chain can see it do (roadmap M11a and M11b).

- Identity, no fork: a signed service record naming operator key and services
- PoW links, spork: hops of operator PoW plus signature as witness data beside the block
- Bitcoin relay: headers and proofs to `btcspv` and `zbtc`, pay for accepted relay work
